WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
    orders.customer_id AS "orders.customer_id",
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.revenue"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  WHERE
    NOT customers.region_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    customers__regions.name,
    orders.customer_id
), _cm_orders__amount_sum_partition_by_customers_regions_name AS (
  SELECT
    customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.region_revenue"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  WHERE
    NOT customers.region_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    customers__regions.name
), base AS (
  SELECT
    _base."orders.customers.regions.name",
    _base."orders.customer_id",
    _base."orders.revenue",
    _cm_orders__amount_sum_partition_by_customers_regions_name."orders.region_revenue"
  FROM _base
  LEFT JOIN _cm_orders__amount_sum_partition_by_customers_regions_name
    ON _base."orders.customers.regions.name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__amount_sum_partition_by_customers_regions_name."orders.customers.regions.name"
), step1 AS (
  SELECT
    "orders.customers.regions.name",
    "orders.customer_id",
    "orders.revenue",
    "orders.region_revenue",
    CASE
      WHEN "orders.revenue" IS NULL
      THEN NULL
      ELSE RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY "orders.customers.regions.name", CASE WHEN "orders.revenue" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ORDER BY "orders.revenue" DESC
      )
    END AS "orders._rank_inner"
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  "orders.customers.regions.name",
  "orders.customer_id",
  "orders.revenue",
  "orders.region_revenue"
FROM (
  SELECT
    "orders.customers.regions.name",
    "orders.customer_id",
    "orders.revenue",
    "orders.region_revenue",
    "orders._rank_inner"
  FROM step1
  WHERE
    "orders._rank_inner" <= 2
) AS _outer
ORDER BY
  "orders.customers.regions.name" ASC,
  "orders.revenue" DESC
LIMIT 100

args.message: Here are the top two customers by revenue in each region, with the region's total revenue on each row. Revenue is the sum of order amounts across all orders, whatever their status. Customers with no region (and orders whose customer isn't in the customer table) are left out. No region had a tie for second place.
